Based on the current estimated location of former Active Regions 14545 and 14549 around E150-E170 and the triangulated analysis, those former regions may be the source for this event.

Preliminary bulk triangulation between SOHO LASCO C2/C3, GOES CCOR-1, and STEREO A COR2, but a good fit of the brightest material and may be final analysis.
